tips.text: Buy the Limbo Blueprint with the Market tile's Blueprint button; the quest never gives it.
Stay in one Syrtis Interception until you have all three Proof Fragments instead of replaying it.
Ask clanmates or recruit chat for spare Proof Fragments to skip the Interception.
Bring levelled Archwing gear; an unmodded rank 3 Odonata makes the Interception painful, and Elytron and Itzal are comfortable picks.
Let enemies that fly outside the mission area despawn; chasing them forces an abort.
Check the Foundry for your fragment count; the game never says you have enough.
Bring a frame that clears fast and protects the extractors; Frost was named.
Expect waits for Power Carrier spawns during the Excavations; it is the most common complaint.
Farm the Argon Crystal right before the Chassis build; it decays at the daily reset.
Keep every part blueprint; the quest cannot be replayed, so a sold one costs Simaris standing.
Expect one evening with a working Archwing; the old horror stories predate the faster builds.
